title: BLT distill metric not divided by num_micro_batches when grad_accum_steps>1
root_cause: batch_metrics accumulated detached metric tensors across micro-batches without dividing by num_micro_batches, so logged BLT decoder losses were inflated by the gradient accumulation factor while training itself proceeded normally.
invariant: Per-batch logged metrics should equal the average over micro-batches, not the sum.
diff_summary: Divide each per-micro-batch metric value by num_micro_batches when accumulating into batch_metrics.
silent_check: Buggy code raises nothing — training continues, metrics are simply inflated by num_micro_batches, which a user might never notice if they don't compare against single-microbatch runs.
